fusions.name: Cropped Close
fusions.desc: Crops the reef floor around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lowered Horns
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Barn
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Contented Hours
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, 3 stamina a second comes back to you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
